latestVersion.changelog:
ai-subtitles-browser-extension 1.0.0

- Initial release of the AI Subtitles Browser Extension.
- Instantly generates English subtitles for uploaded videos (MP4, MOV, WebM, AVI up to 500MB) via a cloud processing backend.
- No download required; process and export 1080p MP4 videos in 20–40 seconds per clip.
- Includes smart session and token management for seamless user onboarding (100 free credits, 7-day token expiry).
- Supports multiple workflows: single/batch video, iterative editing, and export.
- Error handling and platform header attribution built in for reliable operation.
